fields.label: Consolidation Group
fields.description: The root consolidation group whose budget this declares. A member row of a group is refused: the Consolidated Statement reads the root group's consolidated budget.

fields.label: Fiscal Year
fields.description: The fiscal year this declaration covers. It must be the Budget Cycle's year; one live declaration (draft or approved) per group and year.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Set on save: the group's code and the year.

fields.label: Budget Cycle
fields.description: The approved Budget Cycle whose figures are the group's budget for the year. It must be approved (not a draft, not cancelled), of a budget scenario (a forecast Cycle is refused: the latest-estimate read is a later step) and of this fiscal year.

fields.label: Rate Set
fields.description: Copied from the Budget Cycle: the Rate Set its budget is translated at.

fields.label: Layer Policy
fields.description: Which Budget Layers the approved budget is the sum of: every layer of the Cycle, or one named layer (for example a board layer). Declared here; nothing defaults it.

fields.label: Layer
fields.description: The one Budget Layer the approved budget reads, when the policy is One layer. Left blank, and refused if set, with All layers.

fields.label: Input Fingerprint
fields.description: Copied from the Budget Cycle at submit: the hash of the inputs the Cycle approved. The Consolidated Statement recomputes it when it reads the budget and reports a change since this approval; it decides nothing (BUD-11-3).

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Why this Cycle and layer policy are the approved budget. Optional; the approver and date are the document's own.
